description: Constructed deck profile sourced from official Riftbound Core + Tournament rules.

sideboard_max.message: Sideboards of 10 are allowed here because that is what current tournament lists play. Official rules may still cap it at 8 — check your event and trim before you play.

eras.description: Windows in which the banned list did not change. A win rate or a play rate averaged across a ban is a number about a format that no longer exists, so every meta statistic declares which era it describes.

periods.name: Launch
periods.evidence: Every deck in the archive dated on or before 2026-03-28 predates the first banning. 82-87% of decks in each month of this window play at least one card banned today.

periods.name: March 2026 bans
periods.evidence: Derived from the archive, not from an announcement: across 4,218 published lists the last deck containing any of these cards is dated 2026-03-28 and the first list without them is dated 2026-03-29, with zero exceptions on either side. Replace 'source' with the official announcement URL when one is to hand and correct the date if it disagrees.

opening.description: How a game starts, for the opening-hand odds and the draw simulator. Deck construction is the rest of this file's business; these are the only gameplay values it records, and only because a simulator that guessed at them would produce confident, wrong numbers.
opening.evidence: Corroborated across published rules guides in September 2026: a 4-card opening hand from the main deck; an optional one-time mulligan of up to 2 cards placed face down on the bottom of the deck, drawing the same number back; one card drawn per turn in the Draw step. Not read off the Core Rules document this profile cites, which is referenced but not committed to this repository -- so `source` stays empty and the UI says the values are derived rather than cited.
